name: homework-print-bot
description: AI-powered homework print generator and grading system via LINE

scripts.prebuild:agent: docker run --rm -v ./packages/agent:/app -w /app --platform linux/arm64 python:3.12-slim pip install --target ./vendor bedrock-agentcore strands-agents boto3 httpx ulid-py
scripts.cdk:deploy: pnpm run prebuild:agent && pnpm --filter @homework-print-bot/infra cdk deploy
